title: Arcamere Textures
description: This resource pack adds all the custom textures made for Arcamere and renames items to fit its setting.
body:
### Renamed
- Enderman -> Warper
- Ender Chest -> Warp Chest
- Netherrack -> Bloodstone
- (Red) Nether Bricks -> Wet and Dried Bloodstone
- Endstone + Variants -> Porous Stone
- Blaze and Breeze Rods -> Fire and Wind Essence
- Chorus Fruit + Popped -> Distortion Fruit + Solidified Distortion
- Netherwart -> Wart
- Nether Quartz -> Quartz

### Retextured
- Zombie + Variants
- Skeleton + Variants
- Spider + Cave Spider
- (Glow) Squid
- Enderman
- Shulker
